body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Toshiba unveiled its prototype Cell TV at 2009 CES, which brings superb picture quality and networking interactivity to TVs.

Demonstrations at CES include real-time super resolution imaging, using a 56-inch, 4k x 2k pixel panel to display images that the Cell platform upconverts from 1920x1080p to 3840x2160p, and also upconverting of content such as Internet video to high picture quality by application of 'Resolution+' technology in combination with newly developed noise reduction technology.

In addition, a 55-inch backlit LED panel controlled by the Cell platform will be showcased and demonstrate high-speed control of all picture parameters, including an innovative local dimming function. Visitors can also see how the Cell TV goes beyond breathtaking image quality to deliver extremely fast and easy operation of networking functions.
